structured_output.summary: The draft covers B11's scope and done_when, matches the S6 locked card (dark-dirt card, cream name, padlock roundel, dashes for best), and its ids are chosen so the existing track-select, next-track, hay-loop and track-card-press tests stay green. No open PR overlaps it, nothing is retired, and every criterion can be tested through the DOM, the game or exported content data. The remaining findings are minor and go to the builder.

findings.claim: AC1 and AC8 name `getTrack`, `TRACKS`, `nextTrackId` and a new `TRACK_LOCKS` export. The first three are exported content functions that existing tests already pin (next-track, hay-loop, pause-results). `TRACK_LOCKS` is new exported content data. That is a public seam, but this test will freeze its name and shape for good.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep these as they are. The builder should treat `TRACK_LOCKS`'s shape `{ [id]: { afterFinishOn } }` as permanent. AC8's NEXT RACE half is the behaviour the owner sees, so test that through the game as well as through `nextTrackId`.

findings.claim: UI_RULES §7 says "cards lift 2px on hover, locked cards shake". The draft doesn't say what a locked card does on hover or press. In title.css today, every `.ui-track-card` lifts on hover/focus and sinks on `:active`. A locked card would do the same, which suggests it can be selected. UI_RULES gives no amplitude or timing for the shake.
findings.suggestedFix: On the locked card, turn off the hover lift and press sink, but keep the focus ring. Don't invent a shake animation: leave it out until the owner specifies it (see designRequest).

findings.claim: Several existing suites loop over every registered track, and the draft's 'must still pass' list leaves them out. bot.test needs the bot to finish. six-car-race AC5/AC6 need all 6 racers to finish within 5 minutes and the 5 AI finish ticks (seed 7) to be pairwise distinct and the same on a rerun. countdown-framing, countdown-glide and countdown-clear-browser need the car clear of the roundel at 844×390 and 1440×900. tracks.test needs the file id to equal the file name.
findings.suggestedFix: Add tests/sim/bot.test.ts, tests/game/six-car-race.test.ts, tests/render/countdown-framing.test.ts, tests/render/countdown-glide.test.ts, tests/ui/countdown-clear-browser.test.ts and tests/content/tracks.test.ts to the 'must still pass' list. Tune the layout until all of them pass.

findings.claim: The draft puts the localStorage reader/writer for `racer.finished.<id>` in src/content/tracks.ts. All storage access today is in src/ui/best-laps.ts, behind an injectable store (`localBestLaps` / `memoryBestLaps`), and stages use the in-memory store. The new stage 'start--menu-unlocked' needs the same kind of injection. tracks.ts is also imported in plain-Node tests, where `window` doesn't exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep every access in try/catch, including the `window`/`localStorage` lookup itself, so Node and blocked storage both read as locked. Give the start screen an injectable finished/lock reader, like `bestLaps`, so stages can show both states without real storage.

findings.claim: `startScreen.select(trackId)` (called when returning to the menu) and the arrow-key handler don't know about locks. If a locked id is selected programmatically, RACE would start a locked track.
findings.suggestedFix: Make `select()` ignore a locked id. Arrow keys and clicks should skip locked cards, as AC5 says. A locked card can still be focused, but is never checked.

structured_output.designRequest: Track select (S6): UI_RULES §7 says "locked cards shake", but it gives no amplitude, duration, easing or trigger (tap, or Enter/Space on a focused locked card) for the shake, and it isn't in the motion tokens. Please specify the locked-card shake: the axis and distance as a space or hairline token, which duration and easing tokens to use, and the reduced-motion fallback. Please also confirm that a locked card should not hover-lift or press-sink. B11 ships the locked card without the shake until this is specified.
